scenarios.title: Successful multi-step completion
scenarios.invariant: All steps verify before the run completes and the final artifacts report completion.

evidence.test: happy path: all steps done, run completed

scenarios.title: Verification retry then success
scenarios.invariant: A failed verification can retry within its bound and preserves attempt history before success.

evidence.test: retry path: fail then retry then pass

scenarios.title: Failure or explicit block prevents false completion
scenarios.invariant: Failed or blocked steps prevent a completed run and retain their reason.

evidence.test: failure path: step verify fails, run not auto-completed
block path: step blocked with reason

scenarios.title: Human review pauses and records approval or rejection
scenarios.invariant: Human review pauses before later work and the persisted decision controls the terminal state.

evidence.test: human-review pause plus explicit human gate flow completes end to end
gate rejected keeps human-review step blocked

scenarios.title: Risk-sensitive gate behavior
scenarios.invariant: Auto approval follows workflow policy for lower risk while high risk forces human approval.

evidence.test: scenario 02: loop-execution describes auto-approve path
scenario 03: loop-execution states high risk forces human gates

scenarios.title: Browser fallback and unsupported verification
scenarios.invariant: Unavailable browser verification pauses for review and unknown verification types block clearly.

evidence.test: browser verify downgrades to human-review pause
unsupported verify type blocks with clear reason

scenarios.title: Interrupted-run discovery and verify-first recovery
scenarios.invariant: Interrupted state is found across worktrees and resumes through verification before advancement.

evidence.test: locator finds interrupted isolated-worktree run from authoring checkout by workflow
resuming skill exists with verify-first and sidecar state

scenarios.title: Execution-root and worktree safety
scenarios.invariant: Isolation modes resolve predictably and unsafe branch or dirty-worktree states stop.

evidence.test: prepare-execution-root defaults to an isolated worktree and bootstraps the workflow file
prepare-execution-root blocks on non-HOTL dirty files
prepare-execution-root rejects worktree host on protected branches

scenarios.title: Multiple runs require explicit identity
scenarios.invariant: State-changing commands cannot silently select one of multiple runs.

evidence.test: step commands require explicit run id when multiple runs exist

scenarios.title: Incremental reporting, final rendering, and finish disposition
scenarios.invariant: Run events update durable reports and an explicit finish decision is recorded after execution.

evidence.test: report is updated incrementally at each transition
finish records a kept outcome in state, summary, and report
demo simulation flow renders report and compact Codex summary

scenarios.title: Executor profiles share the core state machine
scenarios.invariant: Loop, manual, and delegated profiles preserve one verification, gate, report, and completion authority.

evidence.test: loop-execution and executing-plans contain identical Branch/Worktree Preflight section
subagent-execution references the canonical execution state machine
